system.name: NaturalSpeech 3
system.one_liner: A zero-shot TTS system: a factorized neural codec splits speech into content, prosody, timbre and detail, and factorized diffusion generates them.

content.variant_note: two modules side by side: a factorized diffusion stack from text to attribute codes, and a codec whose decoder turns the codes plus a timbre embedding into speech
content.argues: Speech is factorized into prosody, content and detail codes plus a timbre embedding: a factorized diffusion model generates the codes with in-context prompts and a codec decoder turns them into speech.
content.subject: The overview of NaturalSpeech 3: a stack of factorized diffusion modules from text to attribute codes, and a codec encoder, code slot and decoder around speech.

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw a system with two sub-models as two parallel bottom-up columns: a tinted container holding a stack of equal-width, differently tinted modules, and a plain encoder-to-decoder column, meeting in one dashed rounded slot for the shared codes; define the symbols in a three-row legend.
lessons.suits: Factorized or disentangled generative systems where several attribute generators feed a shared code interface of a decoder: TTS, audio codecs, multi-condition latent diffusion.

summary: NaturalSpeech 3 is a zero-shot text-to-speech system that splits speech into subspaces of content, prosody, timbre and acoustic details and generates each separately. Figure 1 is the architecture overview in one drawing, read bottom-up in two columns. On the left a peach Factorized Diffusion box, tagged with a circled IC for in-context learning, stacks Phoneme Encoder, Duration, Prosody, Content and Detail Diffusion modules, each a differently tinted box joined by up arrows from Text y. Their outputs merge into a dashed slot holding the codes z_p z_c z_d. On the right a blue Codec Encoder takes Speech x and feeds the slot and the timbre embedding h_t, and a Codec Decoder turns codes and h_t into Speech x. A three-row legend at the top left defines the symbols.
summary_zh: NaturalSpeech 3是零样本语音合成系统，把语音分解为内容、韵律、音色和细节分别生成。图1为总览：左侧带IC标记的因子化扩散栈生成码z_p z_c z_d，右侧编解码器提取码与音色h_t并合成语音。
notes: The index lists 3 panels and the source folder holds two scaling plots, but the printed Figure 1 is the single overview drawing (the caption describes only the overview); the digest reports a drawn extent much larger than the canvas, which the preview does not show. The 'Phoneme Encoder' role is taken from its name and its position under Text y. In the paper's text the duration is generated first, then prosody, content and detail; the figure's up arrows follow the same order.
